text:
Maya - CS: Heads-up from todays onboarding call with BeaconHealth. They had a few product asks and a couple of blockers for their renewal. Need us to capture cleanly for triage.
Drew - PM: Thanks Maya. Please keep each ask to one sentence + fields: customer, summary, outcome, cadence, severity, renewal_risk (yes/no). Well label priority P0/P1/P2 and estimate S/M/L during triage.
Casey - CS: Copy. From notes:
- Route-level billing breakouts (customer wants per-route + model variant breakdown to match their GL) -> affects renewals if not solved (finance wants 30d historical)
- Guided onboarding script for infra teams (they were blocked by key rotation and env var names) -> outcome: <15min setup for infra engineer
- Embedding dedup/garbage-collection controls in console (duplicates after CSV import) -> intermittent search regressions

Drew - PM: Slightly different framing from PilotX thread. We should avoid reusing "per-route cost" phrasing in the filename. Use unique wording.
Rafi - Eng: Q on the billing ask  do they require per-call granularity or aggregated daily totals? Daily totals are easier.
Casey - CS: They specifically asked for daily historical (30d) exports to reconcile. Theyre escalating on renewal thread.
Noah - ProdOps: Tagging the billing ask as renewal-risk and assigning to billing-exports queue. We can deliver a 30d daily agg via existing logs; dev work 2 days (M).
Drew - PM: Proposed triage template (CSV headers):

customer,summary,expected_outcome,frequency,severity,renewal_risk,priority,estimate,notes
BeaconHealth,Route-level billing breakouts,30d daily per-route export,daily,high,yes,P0,M,Finance needs line-item for invoices
BeaconHealth,Onboarding script,<15min infra setup,one-off,medium,no,P1,S,Add terraform + env helper
BeaconHealth,Embedding GC and dedup controls,prevent duplicate embeddings,intermittent,medium,no,P2,M,Need sample imports

Rafi - Eng: For embedding dedup we need a sample CSV and timestamps to reproduce. Casey - can you request a 50-row sample and recent import log?
Casey - CS: Yep, will ask and attach to the ticket. Also scheduling a 30-min triage with Drew + Rafi tomorrow 11am PST.
Maya - CS: Also noted BeaconHealth asked for route-level SLA percentiles; moving to observability backlog unless renewal indicates P0.
IntercomBot: Imported convo #84721: "BeaconHealth: After bulk CSV import we see repeated vectors  appears to be duplicate rows"
Drew - PM: After triage we'll add owners and push P0 to weekly roadmap if needed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
